GitHub：X-Hub-Signature-256；Gitea：X-Gitea: GitHub: X-Hub-Signature-256; Gitea: X-Gitea-Signature; GitLab: X-Gitlab-Token. Secrets stay on the server.
Pinned 固定任务快照，任务期间不会自动切换。: Pinned mode fixes the task snapshot and does not switch during a task.
Dynamic 的新 open 可读取新版本；已打开句柄保持旧内容。多次 ope: Dynamic mode exposes updates to new opens; existing handles retain old content. Multiple opens do not guarantee task-level consistency.
Linux FUSE 首发。macOS / Windows 尚未完成兼容验收。离: Linux FUSE is supported. Native macOS / Windows mounting is not yet qualified. Offline policy:
凭据仅授权此终端所属 Profile。轮换后旧凭据立即失效。: Credentials authorize only this client's Profile. Rotation immediately invalidates the old credentials.
此操作会影响后续同步或客户端访问。已发布快照仍保留用于审计和回滚。: This affects subsequent synchronization or client access. Published snapshots remain available for audit and rollback.
现在复制并保存到权限为 0600 的文件。请勿将令牌写入日志或仓库。: Copy and save them in a file with permissions 0600. Do not put tokens in logs or repositories.

选择平台托管或外部 Git 来源。平台静态校验 Skills，不执行仓库内容。: Choose hosted or external Git. Skiva statically validates Skills without executing repository content.
main 默认禁止强推和删除。创建后配置 Git Token 即可推送；Push: Force pushes and deletion on main are blocked by default. Configure a Git Token to push; a push does not publish to Stable.
私网 Git 需在服务端 SKIVA_GIT_ALLOWLIST 中明确配置主机: Private Git hosts must be listed in SKIVA_GIT_ALLOWLIST on the server. Secrets reference server environment variables only.
明确授权视图与离线行为，为不同 Agent 分配独立配置。: Define explicit access and offline behavior for each Agent.
Dynamic · 新打开可见更新: Dynamic · Updates visible on new opens
租约超时后拒绝读取（敏感内容）: Deny reads after lease expiry (sensitive content)
固定快照（留空使用首次挂载时的渠道快照）: Pinned snapshot (leave empty to use the channel snapshot at first mount)
allow_cached 无法同时保证断网期间即时撤权。dynamic 不保证跨: allow_cached cannot guarantee immediate offline revocation. dynamic does not guarantee task-level consistency across multiple opens.
为每个终端签发独立、限定 Profile 的工作负载凭据。: Issue separate, Profile-scoped workload credentials for each client.

默认继承 Stable 中所有 Skills，替换版本后重新预览。: All Stable Skills are inherited by default. Preview again after replacing versions.

创建快照本身不会修改渠道。渠道推进时会原子更新 generation。: Creating a snapshot does not change a channel. Channel promotion updates generation atomically.
确认所选版本组成完整发布视图，且已审阅全部安全风险。: Confirm that the selected versions form a complete release view and that all security risks have been reviewed.
使用同一快照从 Canary 提升到 Stable。回滚仅切换指针，不重新构建。: Promote the same snapshot from Canary to Stable. Rollback changes the pointer without rebuilding.
发布后将在这里记录操作者、原因和历史快照。: After publication, this lists actors, reasons, and historical snapshots.
说明验证结果或回滚原因: Describe validation results or the reason for rollback
目标将替换此渠道的完整视图，影响所有绑定此渠道的动态 Profile。: The target replaces this channel's complete view and affects all dynamic Profiles bound to it.

轮换：创建新 Token，更新 Git 凭据管理器，验证后撤销旧 Token。A: To rotate: create a token, update your Git credential manager, verify access, then revoke the old token. Agent delivery credentials cannot access Git.
默认禁止强推和删除受保护分支。仓库写权限不授予发布 Stable 的权限。: Force pushes and deletion of protected branches are blocked by default. Repository write access does not grant Stable release permission.
新的 Git 访问将停止。源仓库、历史快照和已发布制品会保留，名称继续保留。: New Git access will stop. The source repository, historical snapshots, and published artifacts remain; the name stays reserved.
该成员的新 Git 请求将按剩余权限重新授权；现有 Token 不再授予已移除的: New Git requests are authorized against remaining permissions. Existing tokens no longer grant the removed repository access.
新 Git 请求会立即被拒绝。已开始的传输最多运行至 120 秒超时。: New Git requests will be rejected immediately. Transfers already in progress can run until the 120-second timeout.
